description: mitto-3od.6: echoes the close-phase knowledge-router's PromptProcessorTracked dispatch_id back in the MITTO_PROCESSOR_COMPLETION envelope, via the mock ACP server's regex capture-group substitution (tests/mocks/acp-server/handler.go expandCaptures). This lets the archive -> ApplyOnClose -> auxiliary dispatch -> close-router.json sidecar handshake be exercised end-to-end without weakening parseProcessorCompletion's exact dispatch_id match.
